values.note: Closed for the 2026 season to replace aging infrastructure and repair Hurricane Helene damage (USFS alert, July 8, 2026); all loops, bathhouses, the dump station and the parking area closed. No reopening date announced.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/grindstone-campground-and-parking-closed-2026 ('Grindstone Campground and its parking area will be closed for the remainder of the 2026 season due to the replacement of aging infrastructure and damage caused by Hurricane Helene', Alert Start Date: July 8, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232180 (notice: 'the facility will be closed for the 2026 season ... All Camping Loops are closed'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232180 (Facilities: 'Standard electric sites have 30 amp service and a water hook-up'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2025 first-come season (April 1 - November 30): standard electric and non-electric sites $24/night; the same $24 is posted for the planned 2027 season. Closed for 2026.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232180/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2025-04-01 to 2025-11-30: 'Walk InSTANDARD ELECTRIC': 24, 'Walk InSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 24), read 2026-10-21

note: High-elevation mountain campground; not waterfront. --AWH  USFS campground in the Mount Rogers National Recreation Area (George Washington and Jefferson National Forests), at 3,800 ft in the Fairwood Valley; standard electric sites have 30-amp service and water. Closed for the 2026 season (USFS alert, July 8, 2026) to replace aging infrastructure and repair Hurricane Helene damage; no reopening date announced, so verify before relying on it. --Claude

awh_superseded.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232180 (a George Washington and Jefferson National Forests facility, contact sm.fs.mrnra@usda.gov, 'The Mount Rogers National Recreation Area spans 200,000 acres of National Forest') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/grindstone-campground-and-parking-closed-2026

summary: Confirmed the 2026 closure (USFS alert + rec.gov notice; reason now stated, no reopening date), $24 standard site rate (2025 rate table), 30-amp electric with water. Note rewritten: dropped AWH's superseded 'Private' (USFS campground), kept the rest of his wording. Not stated: site count/max length (the catalog is all placeholder MANAGEMENT sites while closed), season, booking window.
flags: Missing phone: rec.gov says 'This location is unstaffed. To speak with our main office for general information, please call: (276) 783-5196' (Mount Rogers NRA).

Booking: the derived reservable: true (from note prose) is doubtful. Every rec.gov rate season since 2022 (2023, 2024, 2025, and the planned 2027 and 2028) is a 'First-come, First-served Season' with 'Walk In' prices; the last reservable 'Peak Season' is 2022. Grindstone may be first-come only when it reopens; left unchanged because no page says so outright.

Missing agency website: the USFS campground page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/grindstone-campground) currently answers 404; the forest's camping index is https://www.fs.usda.gov/activity/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins/.
